summary: All round-1 findings are fixed, and the change is ready. `/health` now returns 200 only after the custom-host and creator-host checks have failed (F1), and the durable tests confirm creator-host isolation and that a custom domain's app serves its own `/health`. The IAM role now includes the `use` and `certmaps` permissions (F2), and the unreachable cleanup branch is gone (F3). The stale archived temp tests are removed (F4), and a new temp test covers the `APP_DOMAIN_*` config parsing. The remaining main.ts and Pulumi lines are exempt with acceptable reasons (F5). Both test tiers pass and the coverage gate passes.
